## Progress

- Merged [PR #11](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/11): SystemState for session expired / no access / not found / offline in en-hi-ar; 404 route; offline banner keeps typed input (browser-verified)
- Left: "Request access" must store and audit the request (needs MDV-P0-017); wire 401/403 from the API client (MDV-P0-011)

## Description

Implement F-05a Session expired, F-05b No access to this facility (Request access), F-05c Page not found (Back to Today), F-05d You are offline (Retry now) with the designed copy, icons and single CTA. API Problem Details 401/403/404 map to these screens; offline detection uses navigator.onLine + failed fetch.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A 403 from any API shows F-05b with copy "You don’t have access to this facility." (microcopy key err.403) and a "Request access" action that creates an access request (stored, audited).
- [ ] **AC2.** An unknown route shows F-05c and states that nothing has been changed.
- [ ] **AC3.** Going offline shows F-05d without losing form input; reconnecting restores the page.
- [ ] **AC4.** Each state is keyboard-accessible, announced to screen readers, and translated (en/hi/ar) with RTL layout for Arabic.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
